explanation: Computed with the bundled Eta configuration using standard CLAS12 settings: model 3, full O(alpha) corrections, beam momentum 6.53 GeV, electron, detected recoil proton, and vcut 0.166 GeV^2. delta is radtot.dat column 6 (sig_Born-corrected ratio), and sigma_born is column 7 (unpolarized Born cross section), copied exactly as EXCLURAD wrote them. All three points produced valid numbers.
